				} else if !grid[i][j] && count == 3 {

}

func countNeighbors(grid [][]bool, x, y int) int {
	count := 0
	for i := -1; i <= 1; i++ {
		for j := -1; j <= 1; j++ {
			if i == 0 && j == 0 {
				continue
			}
			nx, ny := x+i, y+j
			if nx >= 0 && nx < 10 && ny >= 0 && ny < 10 {
				if grid[nx][ny] {
					count++
				}
			}
		}
	}
	return count
}

				} else if !grid[i][j] && count == 3 {

func countNeighbors(grid [][]bool, x, y int) int {
	count := 0
	for i := -1; i <= 1; i++ {
		for j := -1; j <= 1; j++ {
			if i == 0 && j == 0 {
				continue
			}
			nx, ny := x+i, y+j
			if nx >= 0 && nx < 10 && ny >= 0 && ny < 10 {
				if grid[nx][ny] {
					count++
				}
			}
		}
	}
	return count
}

+package main
+
+import (
+	"bytes"
+	"encoding/json"
+	"flag"
+	"fmt"
+	"math/rand"
+	"os"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+)
+
+const (
+	Version = "39.2.0"
+)
+
+type Theme struct {
+	Name  string
+	Color string
+}
+
+var themes = []Theme{
+	{Name: "0", Color: "default"},
+	{Name: "1", Color: "default"},
+	{Name: "2", Color: "default"},
+	{Name: "3", Color: "default"},
+	{Name: "4", Color: "default"},
+	{Name: "5", Color: "default"},
+	{Name: "6", Color: "default"},
+	{Name: "7", Color: "default"},
+	{Name: "8", Color: "default"},
+	{Name: "9", Color: "default"},
+	{Name: "🔥", Color: "default"},
+	{Name: "🔵", Color: "default"},
+	{Name: "🟢", Color: "default"},
+	{Name: "🍛", Color: "default"},
+}
+
+func main() {
+	var (
+		help     bool
+		version  bool
+		themes   bool
+		comp     string
+		raw      bool
+		slurp    bool
+		yaml     bool
+		toml     bool
+		strict   bool
+		noInline bool
+		gameOfLife bool
+	)
+
+	flag.BoolVar(&help, "h", false, "print help")
+	flag.BoolVar(&help, "help", false, "print help")
+	flag.BoolVar(&version, "v", false, "print version")
+	flag.BoolVar(&version, "version", false, "print version")
+	flag.BoolVar(&themes, "themes", false, "print themes")
+	flag.StringVar(&comp, "comp", "", "print completion script")
+	flag.BoolVar(&raw, "r", false, "treat input as a raw string")
+	flag.BoolVar(&slurp, "s", false, "read all inputs into an array")
+	flag.BoolVar(&yaml, "yaml", false, "parse input as YAML")
+	flag.BoolVar(&toml, "toml", false, "parse input as TOML")
+	flag.BoolVar(&strict, "strict", false, "strict mode")
+	flag.BoolVar(&noInline, "no-inline", false, "disable inlining in output")
+	flag.BoolVar(&gameOfLife, "game-of-life", false, "play the game of life")
+
+	flag.Usage = func() {
+		fmt.Println()
+		fmt.Printf("  fx %s\n", Version)
+		fmt.Println("    Terminal JSON viewer")
+		fmt.Println()
+		fmt.Println("  Usage")
+		fmt.Println("    fx data.json")
+		fmt.Println("    fx data.json .field")
+		fmt.Println("    curl ... | fx")
+		fmt.Println()
+		fmt.Println("  Flags")
+		fmt.Println("    -h, --help            print help")
+		fmt.Println("    -v, --version         print version")
+		fmt.Println("    --themes              print themes")
+		fmt.Println("    --comp <shell>        print completion script")
+		fmt.Println("    -r, --raw             treat input as a raw string")
+		fmt.Println("    -s, --slurp           read all inputs into an array")
+		fmt.Println("    --yaml                parse input as YAML")
+		fmt.Println("    --toml                parse input as TOML")
+		fmt.Println("    --strict              strict mode")
+		fmt.Println("    --no-inline           disable inlining in output")
+		fmt.Println("    --game-of-life        play the game of life")
+		fmt.Println()
+		fmt.Println("  More info")
+		fmt.Println("    https://fx.wtf")
+		fmt.Println()
+		fmt.Println("  Author")
+		fmt.Println("    Anton Medvedev <anton@medv.io>")
+		fmt.Println()
+	}
+
+	flag.Parse()
+
+	if help {
+		flag.Usage()
+		os.Exit(0)
+	}
+
+	if version {
+		fmt.Println(Version)
+		os.Exit(0)
+	}
+
+	if themes {
+		printThemes()
+		os.Exit(0)
+	}
+
+	if comp != "" {
+		printCompletion(comp)
+		os.Exit(0)
+	}
+
+	if gameOfLife {
+		playGameOfLife()
+		os.Exit(0)
+	}
+
+	var input string
+	if len(flag.Args()) > 0 {
+		input = flag.Args()[0]
+	} else {
+		data, err := os.ReadFile("/dev/stdin")
+		if err != nil {
+			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "fx: failed to read stdin: %v\n", err)
+			os.Exit(2)
+		}
+		input = string(data)
+	}
+
+	if input == "" {
+		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "fx: no input file or data provided\n")
+		os.Exit(2)
+	}
+
+	var data interface{}
+	if yaml {
+		data = parseYAML(input)
+	} else if toml {
+		data = parseTOML(input)
+	} else {
+		if raw {
+			data = input
+		} else {
+			var jsonData interface{}
+			if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(input), &jsonData); err != nil {
+				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "fx: invalid JSON: %v\n", err)
+				os.Exit(2)
+			}
+			data = jsonData
+		}
+	}
+
+	printJSON(data, noInline)
+}
+
+func printThemes() {
+	for _, theme := range themes {
+		fmt.Printf("export FX_THEME=\"%s\"\n", theme.Name)
+		fmt.Println("{")
+		fmt.Printf(`  "string": "Fox jumps over the lazy dog",`)
+		fmt.Println("\n  \"number\": 1234567890,")
+		fmt.Printf(`  "boolean": true,`)
+		fmt.Println("\n  \"null\": null,")
+		fmt.Printf(`  "collapsed": {"preview":…}`)
+		fmt.Println("\n}")
+	}
+	fmt.Println()
+}
+
+func printCompletion(shell string) {
+	if shell == "bash" {
+		fmt.Println("complete -o filenames -C fx fx")
+	} else if shell == "zsh" {
+		fmt.Println("#compdef fx")
+		fmt.Println()
+		fmt.Println("_fx() {")
+		fmt.Println("    local -a reply")
+		fmt.Println("    reply=(\"${(@f)$(COMP_ZSH=\"${LBUFFER}\" fx)}\")")
+		fmt.Println("    if (( ${#reply} )); then")
+		fmt.Println("        local -a insert_files display_files insert_other display_other")
+		fmt.Println("        local line display rest value typ")
+		fmt.Println("        ")
+		fmt.Println("        for line in \"${reply[@]}\"; do")
+		fmt.Println("            display=\"${line%%$'\\t'*}")
+		fmt.Println("            rest=\"${line#*$'\\t'}")
+		fmt.Println("            value=\"${rest%%$'\\t'*}")
+		fmt.Println("            typ=\"${rest#*$'\\t'}")
+		fmt.Println()
+		fmt.Println("            if [[ \"$typ\" == \"file\" ]]; then")
+		fmt.Println("                display_files+=(\"$display\")")
+		fmt.Println("                insert_files+=(\"$value\")")
+		fmt.Println("            else")
+		fmt.Println("                display_other+=(\"$display\")")
+		fmt.Println("                insert_other+=(\"$value\")")
+		fmt.Println("            fi")
+		fmt.Println("        done")
+		fmt.Println()
+		fmt.Println("        if (( ${#insert_files} )); then")
+		fmt.Println("            compadd -f -d display_files -a insert_files")
+		fmt.Println("        fi")
+		fmt.Println("        if (( ${#insert_other} )); then")
+		fmt.Println("            compadd -S '' -d display_other -a insert_other")
+		fmt.Println("        fi")
+		fmt.Println("    fi")
+		fmt.Println("}")
+		fmt.Println()
+		fmt.Println("if [ \"$funcstack[1]\" = \"_fx\" ]; then")
+		fmt.Println("    _fx \"$@\"")
+		fmt.Println("else")
+		fmt.Println("    compdef _fx fx")
+		fmt.Println("fi")
+	}
+}
+
+func playGameOfLife() {
+	rand.Seed(time.Now().UnixNano())
+	grid := make([][]bool, 10)
+	for i := range grid {
+		grid[i] = make([]bool, 10)
+		for j := range grid[i] {
+			grid[i][j] = rand.Float32() < 0.2
+		}
+	}
+
+	for i := 0; i < 100; i++ {
